kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نأتمر (form VIII)
# نَأْتَمِرُ (naʔtamiru) /naʔ.ta.mi.ru/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِئْتَمَرَ (iʔtamara)
# نَأْتَمِرَ (naʔtamira) /naʔ.ta.mi.ra/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِئْتَمَرَ (iʔtamara)
# نَأْتَمِرْ (naʔtamir) /naʔ.ta.mir/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِئْتَمَرَ (iʔtamara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
